summary: Owner request (2026-11-05, #1010): source and defend the two open bridges of WF-FAILS-AS-DESCRIPTION-OF-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE. Pinned and read: Dei Filius ch. 4 and canons IV (Latin, vatican.va), CIC 1983 cann. 747-755 and 1364-1369 (Latin, vatican.va; Book VI as revised 2021), Summa contra Gentiles I.2 n.2-I.3 n.2 (Corpus Thomisticum), PU §373 (pinned German), SEP Fideism §3. (a) is supported by the practice's law of teaching (can. 749 §2), membership (cann. 750-751, 1364-1365), its self-description (Dei Filius ch. 4, can. IV.3 on the declared sense of dogma) and Wittgenstein's 'Theologie als Grammatik'; (b) by Dei Filius ch. 4 (two orders distinct in principle; God known by the gentiles) and SCG I.2-3 (natural reason to which all must assent, against pagans; the philosophers' proofs). The fideist replies are recorded at full strength as unattributed alternatives (conciliar teaching is theology, not grammar; natural reason within a theological horizon), with the supports they have (Phillips 2005, 75; Clayton and Taylor) and the texts against them as attacks. Rejected: recording either bridge as stated (no text states it; each source leaves a named gap) or the attacks as refutations (their premises are stated, not established). Logic-first follow-up for the Moorean candidate batch (#1119, 2026-11-06): the grammar-case vocabulary now exists (FIDEISM-GRAMMAR-CASES-PARTITION), so its absence is no longer the blocker. The exact original Challenge still has three unestablished inputs, including the stated CouncilDefinesNaturalKnowabilityReading, not only these two bridges. FideismFailsAsDescription is the negation of InternalGrammarReading ∧ CutOffReading; the recorded alternative to revelation is CutOffReading alone. No refutes relation targets that single rival. In-memory frontier settlement probes at main 0367eebc establish the bundle-failure result if all three inputs are hypothetically settled, but do not refute CutOffReading or lower any route. See docs/notes/moorean-floor-candidates.md for the ranked candidate batch, precise scopes and remaining registration/interpretation gaps. Religious-language endpoint audit (2026-11-06): preserved the unbound later-Phillips internality and face-value source statements; their broad automatic alternative edge is now a guarded attack. New analyst local content/belief/fact/truth and matched cross-discourse profiles show internal truth variation is not automatically nonreference or nondescriptiveness. An actual religious non-descriptive witness rejects local descriptive status; a same-content religious truth-difference witness rejects only the stronger uniform profile. Unrelated-sentence variation does not supply that witness. Checked structural local-uniform/local-difference/local-failure coverage and explicit open local-menu coverage preserve the further relevant option. Three profile controls and an independent non-description model retain both serious criticisms without inventing source identities. Source-fidelity of minimalist descriptive-role denial and applicability of the analyst profiles remain open. Review correction (P1, #1159): the coarse ReligiousSemanticModels third conjunct exports only local failure, not which clause fails; its second also does not export that truth variation occurs on a nonreligious sentence or that the matched religious scope is inhabited. Narrowed those old descriptions without changing their frozen Challenge/type. A stronger DetailedReligiousSemanticModels target now exports actual matched religious content, explicitly nonreligious variation, an actual belief failure with the other local clauses retained, and an actual descriptive failure with the other clauses retained. Its Boolean sentence/content dictionary also exports truth agreement with the assigned fact criterion in each discourse, avoiding reliance on hidden witness properties or empty matched scopes.
blocker: The two interpretation bridges and the council premise remain unestablished. Grammar-case vocabulary is available, but the original theorem refutes a conjunction, whereas the recorded revelation rival is its CutOffReading conjunct alone. A counted single-rival refutation needs a checked specialization with an established InternalGrammar/profile premise, or a justified revision to the recorded rival bundle, and all its premises established. The relation's external-signs/shared-reason reading also remains untyped. Two bridge approvals alone do not close revelation; more sourcing is not on the critical path.
